Name: KivoValley Ooparts
Author: Trans1st0r
Description:
Need these mods to work:
[list=1]
[*]Content Patcher
[*]Producer Framework Mod
[*]Item Extension
[*]KivoValley NPC Collection
[*]Trinket Tinker
[/list]需要以上mod来启用

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
If u have no idea what this mod will do 
[list]
[*]Angel's 24 locates in BUSSTOP and u can enter it whenever except festivel, its Sora's house and u can even enter her room when u have 6 hearts at least
[*]Open the "Sora Shop" u can buy energy potion 3 times a day, and also random ooparts
[*]Click the Peroro dolls at Angel's 24 u can open a shop where u can convert ur useless ooparts to divine crystals
[*]Click the right vending machine u can buy weapon material using Pyroxene and Kivotos basic furniture using Divine Crystal
[*]Click the left vending machine u can buy weapon and hina trinket using the matreial u got from the right machine, these weapon have attack sounds and particle effect. I tried to make them not toooo imba XD
[*]When u get married with NPC like Miyu, Himari who cant be married in origin SDV and have a relationship of 14 hearts u can but their portrait from traveller shop just like u get married with origin SDV NPCs
[*]Hina trinket can heal u when u kill a monster, will fire projectile to damage monsters when u attack or get hurt. She will talk every 10 (or 15? im not sure) seconds and if u stand still over 6 seconds she'll hold a purple heart. So cute :)
[*]Creating stones should be put into creating stele to get ooparts, and normal ooparts can be forged into silver, golden and iridium ooparts using Bead which u can buy from Sora shop. AetherAmpoule can be created using iridium AetherFragment and slime balls (see media picture)
[/list]纯手打中文，看不懂自己机翻或者关注我或者进群捏

V1.0.2
[list=1]
[*]修复小空商店等音爆问题 | Fix sound bugs when u open Sora's shop. 
[*]修复天使24导致的地图交互点丢失bug| Fix bugs that u cant use bus station and minecart when enable Sora
[*]不再需要Sound Tweaker和我的SoundLib作为前置 | No longer need SoundTweaker and KivoValleySoundLib to use
[/list]
V1.0.3
[list=1]
[*] 添加hina饰品，这需要前置Trinket Tinker来激活 | add hina trinket which need "Trinket Tinker" to use. She hovers and will hit monsters with projectile
[*] 可以在天使24的佩洛洛上进行欧帕兹与神名文字的兑换 | can convert useless ooparts to divine crystal by clicking the peroro in Angel's 24
[*] 添加了一套基础的鸡窝咖啡厅家具，可以在右侧的售货机里用神名文字换取 | add a suit of Kivotos furniture, u can exchange it at the right vending machine in Angel's 24
[*] 添加了KivoValley NPC中已经实装的可结婚角色的14心画像，可以在猪车购买 | add 14 hearts portrait for students of "KivoValley NPC", buy them in traveller shop
[*] 目前拥有欧帕兹送礼对话的角色：未花（海莉）、玛丽（潘妮）、爱丽丝（阿比） | （for CN users）
[/list]
